operations.key: Show that the modern Hopfield update $\xi \leftarrow X^\top \operatorname{softmax}(\beta X \xi)$ tends to the stored pattern of uniquely largest overlap as $\beta \to \infty$; ties give the average of maximizing patterns. As $\beta \to 0$, it gives the average of all patterns (continuous update, before any sign readout).
operations.value: 证明现代Hopfield连续更新 $\xi \leftarrow X^\top \operatorname{softmax}(\beta X \xi)$ 在 $\beta \to \infty$ 时趋于唯一最大重叠模式；并列时得到最大重叠模式的平均。在 $\beta \to 0$ 时得到所有模式的平均（连续更新，尚未进行符号读出）。
